note: What builtins were observed to do, measured by this project in a running game. Kept apart from catalog.json on purpose: that file is derived from the MIT-licensed spm-headers and carries its attribution, whereas everything here is bleck's own observation. Grow it with example-mods/builtin-probe; never by inference from a name.
method: scripts/ingame.py <probe> --watch-gw 31 29 0 1 ... --seconds 100. Each slot is pre-seeded with a sentinel so 'returned 0' and 'never wrote' are distinguishable, and a progress marker is set before each call so a hang names the call that caused it. WARNING: the evt global work slots are shared with the game's own scripts, so a reading is only trustworthy while it stays stable across samples -- see D271.

measured.name: evt_pouch_get_coins
measured.summary: Writes the player's coin count into its argument.
measured.observed: 0 with no save file loaded; the sentinel was overwritten, so the call did write.

measured.name: evt_pouch_get_hp
measured.summary: Writes the player's current HP into its argument.
measured.observed: 10 at the start of the attract demo.

measured.name: evt_pouch_get_max_hp
measured.summary: Writes the player's maximum HP into its argument.
measured.observed: 10, matching current HP on a fresh game.

measured.name: evt_pouch_get_level
measured.summary: Writes the player's level into its argument.
measured.observed: 1 on a fresh game.

measured.name: evt_pouch_get_attack
measured.summary: Writes the player's attack power into its argument.
measured.observed: 1 on a fresh game.

measured.name: evt_pouch_get_next_level_xp
measured.summary: Writes the score needed for the next level into its argument.
measured.observed: 10000 at level 1.

measured.name: evt_mario_get_character
measured.summary: Writes which character is active into its argument.
measured.observed: 0 while playing as Mario. The other values are unestablished.

measured.name: evt_mario_get_height
measured.summary: Writes the player's height into its argument, as a float.
measured.observed: exactly 39.0, decoded through evt's fixed-point float encoding.

measured.name: evt_mario_get_pos
measured.summary: Writes the player's x, y and z into its three arguments, as floats.
measured.observed: 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 in the attract demo, where no profile is loaded and the player is never placed (D63). The sentinels were overwritten, so the call did write.

measured.name: evt_pouch_check_have_item
measured.summary: Does not return. Reproduced twice; avoid it until someone establishes why.
measured.observed: the script stops at this call and never reaches the next statement, and the out-parameter keeps its sentinel, so nothing is written. Both runs used item id 1.

measured.name: evt_pouch_get_xp
measured.summary: Writes the player's experience points into its argument.
measured.observed: 0 in the attract demo, with the sentinel overwritten so the call did write. D184 measured get_next_level_xp as 10000, so 0 of 10000 is consistent.

measured.name: evt_mario_check_3d
measured.summary: Writes whether the world is currently flipped into 3D.
measured.observed: 0 during the attract demo, which plays in 2D throughout -- so the value agrees with what is on screen rather than merely being written.

measured.name: evt_sub_get_language
measured.summary: Writes the console's language index.
measured.observed: 2 on a PAL rev 0 disc, identical across two runs. Which language 2 names is not established -- only that the call writes a small stable index.

measured.name: evt_snd_get_last_sfx_id
measured.summary: Writes the id of the most recent sound effect.
measured.observed: 0 in the attract demo, in both runs. Whether that means 'none played' or 'id 0' is not established.

measured.name: evt_guide_get_can_search
measured.summary: Writes whether Tippi's search is currently allowed.
measured.observed: 1 in the attract demo, in both runs.

measured.name: evt_pouch_check_free_use_item
measured.summary: Writes whether the item pouch has a free slot.
measured.observed: 0 with no save loaded, where the pouch does not exist. Not the same as 'the pouch is full'.

measured.name: evt_guide_check_flag0
measured.summary: Takes a flag mask and writes whether it is set.
measured.observed: Called with mask 0 and wrote 0. The call returns and writes; which flags the mask selects is unmeasured.

measured.name: evt_npc_get_active_count
measured.summary: Writes how many NPCs are currently active. Takes one argument, which the catalog does not record.
measured.observed: 0 in aa4_01, the attract demo's first map, which has no NPCs -- the sentinel was overwritten, so the call wrote a real zero. That also settles the arity the catalog leaves blank: one out-parameter.

measured.name: evt_sub_get_mapname
measured.summary: Arity is NOT one out-parameter.
measured.observed: Called with a single argument, the sentinel survived untouched across every sample of a 100-second run while the script ran to completion. So the call returns and writes nothing there. The catalog records no arity for it and one is wrong.

measured.name: evt_npc_get_max_hp
measured.summary: Hangs when its name argument is null.
measured.observed: evt_npc_get_max_hp(0, &out) never returned: the progress marker stopped at its number and stayed for 90 seconds, and the out-parameter kept its sentinel. Its first argument is a const char* name and 0 is a null pointer, so this is a fact about calling it wrongly -- what it does with a real NPC name is still unmeasured.
